scope: Evidence-only generated-three diagnostic helper; no native execution

findings.location: Popen followed by owned=Owned(p,work); Owned.__init__ invokes refresh
findings.problem: Process ownership assignment is not armed until fallible ps discovery succeeds. A ps timeout/error or parse failure after Popen leaves owned=None; exception handler reaches finally without cleaning the launched debugger/session. Existing cleanup also relies on successful ps throughout.
findings.required: Arm a nonthrowing ownership record immediately after launch; guarantee bounded fallback cleanup of the owned process/session if discovery fails, fail closed on unavailable absence readback, and retain failure evidence. Add a lightweight fault-injection regression for initial and cleanup-time discovery failure without SDK/LLDB.

findings.problem: NODE_BACKEND=js is absent and environment inheritance is disabled. Installed bcrypto has no native .node build; bcrypto/lib/sha256.js chooses native unless the variable is js. This can stop the experiment at imports rather than the intended three original tests.
findings.required: Pin the same supported explicit JS backend as prior SDK commands in the inferior environment; do not install/rebuild native dependencies.
